title: EU CBAM default values and benchmarks (JSON and CSV)
description: The EU's official CBAM default values as machine-readable JSON and CSV: direct, indirect and total embedded emissions (t CO2e per tonne of good) for every CN code and every country in Annex I of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by (EU) 2026/1740, plus Annex IV, and the Column A and B benchmarks of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620 with the CBAM factor per year. 11,170 rows, 121 countries. Unofficial compilation based on European Commission data (c) European Union; the Official Journal texts are binding.
